text:
olivia: Heads-up — high-priority customer (acct ACME) reports structured output started flaking after last night's model swap. Optional fields are sometimes missing and some integer fields are coming back as \"N/A\" or strings. They say it started right after the canary finished. full repro below.

customer_jane: seeing this in prod right after the model change. Important fields in our webhook payload are intermittently absent and our downstream validation fails.

olivia: thanks. can you paste a minimal failing example?

customer_jane: here you go:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-llama4b-v1",
  "mode": "json",
  "prompt": "produce user record",
  "max_tokens": 120
}

-- response (sometimes) --
{
  "user_id": 12345,
  "age": "N/A",
  "status": "active",
  "permissions": ["read", "write"]
}

other times: 
{
  "user_id": 12345,
  "status": "active",
  "permissions": null
}
```

kevin: hmm. age as string and permissions as null intermittently. any request_id(s)?

customer_jane: reqs 241234-1, 241234-5, 241234-9 in last 30m.

mike: deploy-bot noted a canary swap at 2026-03-16T23:40Z, finished at 23:58Z, rollout: redwood-llama4b-v1 -> redwood-llama4b-v1-quant.

ana: tagging in ML infra. initial theory: quantized variant might handle tokenization or sampling differently causing truncated structured outputs or additional token-level padding that the JSON postprocessor mis-handles. Could be a minor template change in model output.

ana: quick repro attempt locally with model pair shows sample outputs with occasional \"N/A\" tokens inserted when model hits a tokenization boundary for numeric slots. repro script: 
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-llama4b-v1-quant","mode":"json","prompt":"produce user record","max_tokens":60}' | jq -r .; 
done | grep -n \"N/A\"
```

kevin: good repro. does the output still parse as valid JSON when \"N/A\" used? yes but schema validation fails downstream.

olivia: customer requests rollback if we can't hotfix quickly. they have a hard validation step.

mike: immediate mitigation options: 1) pin customer to previous model revision (redwood-llama4b-v1) via routing rule, 2) enable "strict-field-defaulting" on their account (temporary server-side patch to convert "N/A" -> null for numeric fields), 3) pause canary and re-run unit evals.

ana: root cause hypothesis: small change in pre/post prompt formatting in the quantized variant produced a different token output for numeric placeholders — sometimes emits literal \"N/A\" token when uncertain. I'll run a focused eval across 2k prompts and check token-level diffs.

kevin: customer accepted option 1 for now. Olivia, can you update the routing rule and confirm?

olivia: on it. patching routing to pin ACME to redwood-llama4b-v1 and notifying customer. will follow up with logs and timeline. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary rollback scheduled by olivia at 2026-03-17T00:12Z (auto-confirm disabled).

mike: after pinning, please collect a set of both failing and non-failing responses and attach to this thread — we need token sequences + model variant for each. also include latency and token counts.

customer_jane: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick response. we'll keep monitoring and send any more examples.

olivia: will post results from ANA's eval and next steps in ~2h. if ML finds a simple prompt wrapper fix we can push a hotpatch to the quantized variant.

kevin: adding note — escalate to platform if we see similar reports from other customers; could be a global regression in structured-output handling for quantized models.
